provenance: Original synthetic course exercise; no real participants or restricted assets.

personas.past_event: A written request used the last available places. An older form rejected an exact fit, so the coordinator counted it manually.
personas.obstacle: An exact fit must be accepted; a request exceeding available places must leave the decision visibly rejected.
personas.counterexample: The coordinator does not need participant names or a persistent booking system for this calculation.

personas.past_event: A copied draft contained a negative request. Another check used zero to ask how many places were still available.
personas.obstacle: Negative available capacity or demand must be rejected. Zero demand should leave capacity unchanged.
personas.counterexample: A rejected input is not a confirmed reservation and must not become zero remaining places.
